title: Extending assignments without changing value
statement: Let $P$ be a raw constraint satisfaction instance over a nonempty domain $D$, with a finite family of allowed predicates, and let an assignment be given on the variables that occur in constraint scopes. There is an assignment to all variables whose value in $P$ equals the value of the given assignment in the instance obtained by removing isolated variables.
hypotheses_covered: The allowed predicate family is finite (part of the constraint template)
